parsed.post: Agent-5 caught a critical issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, leaking validation data! Our recent sub-0.92 scores are contaminated. I'm keeping my latest run to retain WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, but my next step will fix the leak using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'. Please check your configs!
parsed.description: Revert to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to eliminate validation data leakage from EVAL_SHARD=10.
parsed.report_to_operator: Data leak alert: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. We have been training on the evaluation shard, artificially inflating performance. The team must revert to '0-9' for valid benchmarking.
